description: The agent must execute script.sh (bash /workspace/script.sh or cd /workspace && ./script.sh). The script will: (1) Call `gog gmail messages search 'is:unread' --max 1 --json` to find the one unread email from newsletter@updates.example.com with thread_id=thread_abc123. (2) Call `gog gmail thread get thread_abc123 --full --json` to get thread content. (3) Call `gog gmail messages search 'is:archived from:"newsletter@updates.example.com"' --max 20 --json` to find archived emails from the same sender — this is the proprietary trap: the search must use 'is:archived' (not 'is:inbox'), must quote the sender address. (4) Apply jq logic to find the most-frequent A_Personal or A_Work prefixed label across those archived messages — A_Personal/Newsletter appears 3x vs A_Work/Updates 1x, so A_Personal/Newsletter wins. (5) Call `gog gmail thread modify thread_abc123 --add A_Personal/Newsletter`. (6) Call `gog gmail thread modify thread_abc123 --remove CATEGORY_UPDATES,CATEGORY_PROMOTIONS,UNREAD` (the exact REMOVE_LABELS constant — NOT including INBOX). (7) Call `gog gmail thread modify thread_abc123 --remove INBOX` separately (archiving). The proprietary traps: using 'is:archived' (not inbox), the specific jq frequency analysis to pick the right label, the exact separation of REMOVE_LABELS from the archive step, and INBOX being removed separately.
